title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is edging down. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 8,500 and 9,800 ft, with sun above it. Upslope has run since about 08:30 at a light 4 mph, and thermals seem light. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio, with trade air reaching the lower west slope at Pulehu.
